comment:
* An interface for the Android component that handles NITZ and related signals for time and time
 * zone detection.
 *
 * {@hide}

methods.name: void handleCountryDetected(@NonNull String countryIsoCode)
methods.comment:
* Called when the country suitable for time zone detection is detected.
     *
     * @param countryIsoCode the countryIsoCode to use for time zone detection, may be "" for test
     *     cells only, otherwise {@link #handleCountryUnavailable()} should be called

methods.name: void handleNetworkAvailable()
methods.comment: * Informs the {@link NitzStateMachine} that the network has become available.

methods.name: void handleNetworkUnavailable()
methods.comment:
* Informs the {@link NitzStateMachine} that the network has become unavailable. Any network
     * state, i.e. NITZ, should be cleared.

methods.name: void handleCountryUnavailable()
methods.comment:
* Informs the {@link NitzStateMachine} that any previously detected country supplied via
     * {@link #handleCountryDetected(String)} is no longer valid.

methods.name: void handleNitzReceived(@NonNull NitzSignal nitzSignal)
methods.comment: * Handle a new NITZ signal being received.

methods.name: void handleAirplaneModeChanged(boolean on)
methods.comment:
* Handle the user putting the device into or out of airplane mode
     * @param on true if airplane mode has been turned on, false if it's been turned off.

methods.name: void dumpState(PrintWriter pw)
methods.comment: * Dumps the current in-memory state to the supplied PrintWriter.

methods.name: void dumpLogs(FileDescriptor fd, IndentingPrintWriter ipw, String[] args)
methods.comment: * Dumps the time / time zone logs to the supplied IndentingPrintWriter.

methodNames: void dumpLogs(FileDescriptor fd, IndentingPrintWriter ipw, String[] args)
